title: Bajo La Luz
style: Orchestral tropical pop with symphonic folk colors, gentle Latin percussion, and swaying nighttime groove; verse stays sparse with acoustic guitar, upright bass, and close duet vocals, pre-chorus adds flutes and soft brass, chorus blooms into layered frog-and-toad choir with strings and congas.
